text:
You said: the fugitive light of your hair

had taken refuge on the pillow

and when I brought my hands near

they turned to water for me,

silk of water.

I felt my body a sea and you upon the beach.

You said: do not spread any more

the musical waterfall,

I want you like this, dressed

in silence and in nothing.

I want you like this, silky,

like this, helpless.

You said it. Because you loved me.

translation.title: You Said: The Fugitive Light of Your Hair...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the intimate second-person address and the hair/water/sea imagery of Soler's love poem.
